remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Infor. from Miss O'Keeffe, 1936 [should be 1946]: 'Red Canna' painted 1920, 7 x 7, in exh. at Anderson Gals, 1924 (not listed in catalogue), sold to Mrs. Herbert Fleischaker.... Letter from Mr. Herbert Fleischaker. 'I am sorry to state that Mrs. Fleischaker gave these pictures away years ago and therefore cannot be of assistance to you.'" Reproduction in auction catalogue, 1969, confused with cat. no. 302. Backing inscription dates 1919. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1920. Dated 1919 on basis of backing inscription and similarities to cat. nos. 296–99. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 15. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Small vertical oil of single reddish orange flower with open petals on a stalk with other closed buds in a background of green and teal.
